text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah, what a truly delightful run that was.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Galloping across the track felt as though 
I had become the pure wind itself...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Did you feel it? My wind.
choice_data_list:
That was the most wonderful, refreshing 
breeze.
I want to feel even more wind!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad to hear that. In that case, 
I'll be sure to win next time as well.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let us savor this pleasant, cool breeze 
together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. To savor this refreshing breeze 
once more, I must dedicate myself even 
further to my training.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please continue to look after me, 
okay?
